what_it_checks: Stationary log-OU initialization and exact one-cell OU update.
derivation: Section 5.3: Y_0 = sigma Z_0. For sigma = 1/2 and Z_0 = 2, Y_0 = 1. For dt/tau = ln(2), a = exp(-ln(2)) = 1/2 and sqrt(1-a^2) = sqrt(3)/2. With Z_1 = 0, Y_1 = aY_0 + sigma sqrt(1-a^2)Z_1 = 1/2. X_1 = exp(Y_1 - sigma^2/2) = exp(1/2 - 1/8) = exp(3/8).
